hook_line: RAJAMOULI'S VARANASI REPORTEDLY SETS RECORD TELUGU THEATRICAL DEAL

hook_stat.sub: Telugu-states theatrical deal reported by 123Telugu; other trade outlets report Rs. 290 crore

stats.label: Reported Telugu-states deal for Rajamouli's RRR, the previous benchmark
Break-even target for distributors in Andhra Pradesh and Telangana, per Sacnilk

diaspora_bullets: Worldwide theatrical release on April 7, 2027, in multiple languages
Music by Oscar-winning composer MM Keeravaani
news_summary: SS Rajamouli's Telugu film Varanasi, starring Mahesh Babu, has reportedly closed its Telugu-states theatrical deal at Rs. 300 crore according to 123Telugu, with other trade outlets reporting Rs. 290 crore and official confirmation still awaited.
payoff: On either reported figure, the deal would exceed the roughly Rs. 225 crore reported for RRR.
